@@U01118@@
I wonder who that gentleman was today. I'd give a lot to know, I would. He looked such a valiant sort; I’m certain he’s of noble blood. You could see it in his face. Otherwise he'd never have been so bold.

@@U01119@@
(She goes out. 浮士德 and 梅菲斯特 enter.)

@@U01121@@
Come in, come, just do it quietly!

@@U01123@@
(After some moments of silence.)

@@U01124@@
I beg of you, please, leave me alone here!

@@U01126@@
(Snooping about.)

@@U01127@@
Not all girls keep their room this tidy.

@@U01128@@
(Exit.)

@@U01130@@
(Looking around.)

@@U01131@@
Welcome, sweet twilight, hovering in this holy sanctuary! Seize on my heart, sweet pain of love, you that live and languish on the dews of hope! About me here I feel the breath of peace, of order, contentment. What fullness I sense in this poverty! What blessédness in this narrow prison! Dear girl, I feel your spirit of order and abundance murmuring around me in the air, the spirit that, like a mother, instructs you daily to spread the clean cloth on the table and strew the sand in patterns on the floor. Dear hand, dear heavenly hand! You've turned this lowly cottage into a paradise.
translation:
@@U01118@@
我想知道今天那位先生是谁。我愿意付出很多知识，我愿意。他看上去是个英勇的人。我确信他有高贵的血统。你可以从他的脸上看到这一点。不然他也不会这么大胆。

@@U01119@@
（她出去。浮士德和梅菲斯特进来。）

@@U01121@@
进来吧，进来吧，安静地做吧！

@@U01123@@
（沉默了一会儿。）

@@U01124@@
我求你了，求你了，让我一个人呆在这里吧！

@@U01126@@
（窥探。）

@@U01127@@
并不是所有女孩都把房间保持得这么整洁。

@@U01128@@
（退出。）

@@U01130@@
（环顾四周。）

@@U01131@@
欢迎，甜蜜的暮光，盘旋在这神圣的圣地！抓住我的心，爱情的甜蜜痛苦，你在希望的露珠中生活和憔悴！我在这里感受到了和平、秩序和满足的气息。在这种贫穷中我感到多么充实啊！在这狭窄的监狱里是多么幸福啊！亲爱的女孩，我感觉到你的秩序和丰富的精神在我周围的空气中低语，这种精神就像母亲一样，每天指示你在桌子上铺上干净的布，在地板上撒上沙子。亲爱的手，亲爱的天上的手！你把这座简陋的小屋变成了天堂。
